reflectionQuestion: Have you ever felt worried about something new, and then it turned out better than you thought?
title: The Catfish Named Potato
theme: worry, nervousness, feeling scared about something unknown
reflectionText:
Amos felt a big knot of worry inside him. Everything looked too large and too new. But then someone kind showed up, and the worry started to get smaller all on its own.

Sometimes the things we are most afraid of turn out to hold unexpected gifts — a friendly voice, a funny name, a feeling of belonging we didn't expect.
